title: Localization smoothness from a radical span
statement: For commutative rings R and A with an R-algebra structure, if f^n belongs to the ideal span of elements g whose principal localizations A_g are smooth over R, then A_f is smooth over R.

proof.text: Use the finite principal-cover argument: after localizing at f, the smooth elements generate the unit ideal; localizations at them are smooth by localization and commuting principal localizations; apply smoothness local on a finite principal cover.

lean.statement: theorem smooth_localization_span_from_radical (R : Type u) (A : Type v) [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] (f : A) (n : ℕ) (hn : f ^ n ∈ Ideal.span (smoothElements R A)) : Smooth R (Localization.Away f)
